name: todo
description: 管理当前会话的待办清单（每会话独立持久化）。action="create" mode="append"（默认）加 text（可选 priority）新建一条；action="create" mode="replace" 加 items（全量待办数组，至少 1 条，每项可选 id/status/priority）整体覆盖清单；action="update" 加 id 与 text/status/priority 至少一项修改；action="list" 查看当前全部待办（含 id，操作前建议先 list）；action="reorder" 加 orderedIds（全量 id 的新顺序排列）重排；action="batch_update" 加 updates 数组一次批量更新多项（任一 id 无效则整体失败不写入）。开始多步任务时建议创建待办并在每步完成后更新状态。任务全部完成后保留 completed 状态即可，无需重建清单。
description_en: Manage the current session's todo list (persisted per session). action="create" mode="append" (default) with text (optional priority) creates one item; action="create" mode="replace" with items (full todo array, at least 1 item, each with optional id/status/priority) replaces the whole list; action="update" with id plus at least one of text/status/priority; action="list" shows all current todos (with ids; listing first is recommended before operating); action="reorder" with orderedIds (a full permutation of ids in the new order); action="batch_update" with an updates array to update multiple items at once (any invalid id fails the whole batch, nothing is written). When starting a multi-step task, create todos and update statuses as steps complete. After everything is done, keep the completed statuses; no need to rebuild the list.

mode.description: create 的模式：append=新建一条（默认，需 text）；replace=全量覆盖清单（需 items，至少 1 条）
mode.description_en: create mode: append=create one item (default, requires text); replace=replace the whole list (requires items, at least 1)

text.description: 待办文本内容。create(mode=append) 必填；update 可选
text.description_en: Todo text content. Required for create(mode=append); optional for update

status.description: 状态。仅 update/batch_update/create(mode=replace 的 items 内) 使用
status.description_en: Status. Only used by update/batch_update/create (inside items when mode=replace)

id.description: 可选，保留原条目身份；不传则自动分配新 id
id.description_en: Optional, preserves the original item identity; a new id is assigned automatically if omitted

items.description: 全量待办列表（整体覆盖现有清单，至少 1 条）。仅 create mode=replace 使用
items.description_en: Full todo list (replaces the existing list entirely, at least 1 item). Only used by create mode=replace

orderedIds.description: 全量待办 id 按新顺序排列。仅 reorder 使用，必须是当前全部 id 的排列
orderedIds.description_en: All todo ids arranged in the new order. Only used by reorder; must be a permutation of all current ids

updates.description: 批量更新列表。仅 batch_update 使用
updates.description_en: List of batch updates. Only used by batch_update
